We are grown up and married, our parents give us authority to take decisions because we have our own family now.

I have authority to decide on our own, the family accept our position as an adult and mature member. I can make my own decisions about my family and job. However still consult our parents in several matters for their guidance. They are very experienced and provide good guidance.

Education is very important and without it a person is blind. If I was educated I would have found good job in government, but due to poverty could not continue it. I will make sure that my children are educated.
. Education is essential for awareness and wisdom and nowadays illiterate person is ignored by the society.

. Majority of children are getting education until secondary, because we now have a government (public) school in the village. Previously this school was middle (8th grade school), so they used to quit their education beyond that.

Its because that farmers were putting a lot of hard work but the production was not good enough, so all the new practices were included to increase the yield.

In our community land belongs to male only. And he decide what to crop and when to crop. It is decided by head of the family or man household members.
